# Step 1 数据理解与清洗
## 读取数据
```{r}
library(readr)

care <- read_csv("./data/care_state.csv")
```
## 检查数据 1
```{r}
head(care)
```

## 检查数据 2
```{r}
library(dplyr)

glimpse(care)
```

## 检查数据缺失值
```{r}
colSums(is.na(care))
```
## 剔除数据缺失值
```{r}
care_clean <- care %>%
  filter(!is.na(score))
colSums(is.na(care_clean))
```
